$comment: Seeded from the frozen v1 discovery schema at the RFC 0266 §C cut-over (byte-equal to the 2.49.12 derivation); v2-owned since, edited by hand.
description: Privacy / compliance behavior advertised to clients (closes O5). Lets consumers know what masking mode is in effect so a `"[REDACTED]"` value in event log payloads is recognizable as a server-side mask vs an upstream null.

defaultMode.description: Server's default masking mode for fields marked sensitive. `mask` (default): replace with `"[REDACTED]"`. `omit`: drop the field entirely. `hash`: replace with `"sha256:<hex>"` for audit-only equality. `passthrough`: record as-is (NOT recommended for production). Workflow authors MAY override per-workflow via `metadata.complianceConfig.maskingMode`. PRIVACY CLASSIFICATION (re-homed from v1 `observability.md` §"Privacy classification" by RFC 0266): a field is marked sensitive by `WorkflowVariable.sensitive`, `WorkflowNode.outputSensitivity`, a pack's `nodes[].outputs[<port>].sensitive` or `ChannelDeclaration.sensitive`, and `WorkflowMetadata.complianceClass` sets the run's tier. A server SHOULD default to `mask` for any field marked sensitive, SHOULD apply masking before the event reaches the durable event log, and SHOULD apply one mode consistently within a run so replays produce identical event logs. The spec does not detect PII: authors and pack maintainers MUST annotate fields.

supportedClasses.description: Compliance classes this server applies special handling for. A server MAY accept all five classes but only enforce stricter retention on a subset; this field declares the operational reality so workflow authors can choose a server appropriately.
